body: Hvězdu ubírám za vysokou cenu. Jinak mně nejvíc vyhovuje Productive. Cena je nižší, vizuálně se mi líbí víc. Ale uznávám, že v některých ohledech má Strides víc funkcí.

body: Very satisfied even without premium. Just the Premium price is a tad high..

title: Great app!
body: Helps me organise my life better and focus on the things that is important to me, keeping me on track! Thanks developers 💜
author: ThuGiiang

title: Almost perfect habit tracker
body:
App is perfect, ui is polished and its possible to track many things.

What would be perfect is daily filter of habits/todos remaining for day so dashboard is not confusing and ovrhelming.

Otherwise i recommend this app for serious get to do self improvement addicts. I tried every possible app and this one really motivates me using it.
author: Mr selfimprovement

title: One big bug
body:
A lot of bugs, totally unstable on both iPad Air and iPhone 6. On iPhone 6 it is impossible to even create acount, app always says "the email adress already in use", menas you cant get to your trackers beein stucked on "login page".

- no categories, filters, tags (promised a long time ago)
- no landscape mode on ipad
- month fees - no problem, but not for such buggy app
- unstable, crashing
- look bad on iPhone 6 display
author: Anders837

title: Nice, but very unstable
body:
Nice habit and goal tracker. 
Unfortunately, this version is  unstable and crashes very often.

title: Great app
body:
This is a great app for tracking your progress with several good options, and flexibility to change the way you track your goals as you go.

I just hope it will be available for iPad soon!
